words: I can lay out 245 US cents at the very most - nothing above that, I'm afraid. And it has to be something I can actually order today - sure what use is a lovely thing that's gone to seed on the shelf? Hi there! I want to buy a formal - the strap material should be a good fit for the value listed on the formal from the seller Dorrimodor - and it should have watch dial size 21 mm - movement type quartz - and color gold. And if that page points you on to another listing - chase it up too. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. We've 40 steps - then we're finished - done or not. I'd happily go with automatic or digital as the movement type. At the school gate – juggling bags – I realised the outfit I've chosen for Saturday's christening still needs its watch.

Tools: summaryBalance(): Shows your meters: how much you've used so far and how much you've got left.; requestConclude(methodChoice=buy|refuse): Use this to finish up. With methodChoice=buy it orders the trolley, with methodChoice=refuse it gives up on the request, and either way the conversation is over; rangeScreen(costAtMost, itemGroup, make, rowRowStart): Looks for listings that match your search. You get 3 listings per call, and you choose the row offset to start from.; itemOpen(listingNumber): Opens up a single listing so you can look at it.; stashToBasket(entries): Sets the trolley contents. Whatever you send replaces the whole trolley with those lines, and you get the whole trolley back.; userSay(words): Sends a note to the user.; listingsLocate(freeQ, listFirst): Searches through listings and hands back 3 rows per call. Use a row offset to pick where to begin.; bag(): Shows what you've got in the trolley right now.; listingsMatchUp(chosenRefs): Lays out a comparison of listings in a single view, for up to 3 listings.
